records.title: Now get a USDC loan without selling your crypto — XRP collateral update
records.summary: Coinbase's product announcement says eligible U.S. customers outside New York can borrow up to $100,000 in USDC against XRP, SOL, ADA, LTC or DOGE without selling the collateral. The loans are powered by Morpho on Base; the product began with BTC and expanded to additional assets.
records.limitations: Official product description, not a customer-origination ledger. It does not disclose Coinbase-interface share of the permissionless Morpho market, borrower identities, actual loan balances by collateral asset, or onward use of proceeds.

records.title: USDC loan collateral — collateral held on Morpho
records.summary: Coinbase states loan collateral is held and locked on Morpho, is marked locked and not tradeable in the Coinbase balance view, and is returned after full repayment plus fees and accrued interest. LLTV varies by asset. The page states a 4.38% liquidation penalty and also contains a generic 86% example; that generic figure is not substituted for the cbXRP market's specific 62.5% LLTV.
records.limitations: The page's 4.38% penalty does not reconcile with the Morpho market page's 12.67% liquidation penalty/bonus. The page's generic 86% example is not the XRP/cbXRP market threshold. Exact fee mechanics require clarification.

records.title: USDC loan backup site — XRP collateral requires cbXRP on Base
records.summary: Coinbase's asset-requirements table explicitly maps an XRP-backed loan to cbXRP collateral on Base and publishes contract 0xcb585250f852c6c6bf90434ab21a00f02833a4af. The backup path requires a supported self-custody wallet and the user's own pre-obtained secure link.
records.limitations: The backup page documents adding collateral during service unavailability; it does not disclose normal Coinbase UI routing, market-specific borrower attribution, or the amount of XRP collateral currently pledged.

records.title: USDC loan health — market-specific LLTV and liquidation rules
records.summary: Coinbase states each Morpho market has a predetermined LLTV, that the threshold varies by collateral asset, and gives 62.5% as one explicit example. It describes loan-health bands, collateral top-ups, and warns that protection is not guaranteed against liquidation.
records.limitations: The page is generic and does not itself identify the cbXRP market ID; the exact 62.5% match is cross-referenced with the Morpho market page.

records.title: cbXRP / USDC on Base — Morpho market data snapshot
records.summary: The page reports $65.42M USDC supplied, $59.11M borrowed, 90.4% utilization, $6.31M immediately available, $148.9M collateral (118.46M cbXRP), 6.83% supply APY, 7.59% borrow APY, 62.5% LLTV, 11,968 open loans, 1,120 liquidations in 30 days and $3.94M debt repaid. It reports a 12.68% liquidation bonus and approximately $21.48M collateral at risk under a 20% cbXRP price decline.
records.limitations: Independent Morpho Watch project, not affiliated with Coinbase or Morpho. Data is Morpho API/blockchain-derived and market-wide, not Coinbase-customer-only. The page's claim that this is the market behind Coinbase XRP loans is an inference from public on-chain/product matching, not an official Coinbase market-ID disclosure.

records.title: Morpho Base market 0xd4a903…6e4109 — USDC collateralized by cbXRP
records.summary: The Morpho app identifies the Base USDC/cbXRP market, market ID 0xd4a903dc6d949519060c7707f9604fdc9772c046e05c2e3a8fce0bd7196e4109, 62.5% LLTV, $59.16M outstanding loans, 0 displayed realized/unrealized bad debt, a 12.67% liquidation penalty/bonus display, and Chainlink as the XRP/USD oracle provider. It shows a 1-day heartbeat and 0.5% deviation setting. It lists Steakhouse, Clearstar, K3, Gauntlet and Yearn vaults among suppliers.
records.limitations: The page also displays $15.31M total liquidity, $74.47M total market size and 91.67% utilization; those fields do not arithmetically reconcile with each other or the Morpho Watch aggregate snapshot. They are preserved raw but excluded from liquidity features until definitions and block cutoffs are reconciled.

records.title: USDC on Base — native issuance and Circle Mint/API support
records.summary: Circle lists native USDC on Base and identifies Circle Mint and Circle APIs as access routes. This establishes Circle as issuer of the USDC asset used in the cbXRP/USDC Morpho market.
records.limitations: Circle's network support does not establish that Circle supplies USDC to this Morpho market, acts as lender, or directly routes USDC from XRPL to Base.

records.title: Now available: USDC on the XRP Ledger
records.summary: Circle announced native USDC on XRPL mainnet, with Circle Mint and Circle APIs supporting the network. This is a separate native network deployment from USDC on Base; the two deployments do not by themselves prove a direct bridge or cross-chain capital flow.
records.limitations: Announcement establishes network availability, not current XRPL supply, active payment volume, or a Base↔XRPL transfer route.

records.title: Coinbase adds XRP, DOGE, ADA and LTC as collateral for onchain loans via Morpho
records.summary: The Block reported Coinbase's February 18, 2026 expansion to XRP and other collateral, up to $100,000 USDC for the new assets, a 49% maximum initial LTV and 62.5% liquidation threshold, Morpho execution on Base, Coinbase as interface, variable rates, and a restriction against using proceeds to trade on Coinbase.
records.limitations: Secondary reporting. Product terms can change; official Coinbase pages are preferred for current eligibility and market-specific parameters. It does not attribute all public Morpho market activity to Coinbase.
